job: See what ran, what runs in parallel and what comes after, for one run.
purpose: Staged work read left to right: stages in order, jobs in a stage run in parallel, and every job shows a status icon and a word for screen readers. It turns vertical in narrow containers. A job can be a button that selects, a link or plain text. A stage with data-when runs on a condition and joins by a dashed link. It is not a node editor.
useWhen: A crawl, deploy, data job or agent plan has stages and parallel jobs.
A run page lets people pick a failed job and read it beside the graph.

avoidWhen.when: Steps that run one after another.
A free-form graph with arbitrary edges and dragging.
